notes.title: Live With Logan: The 7-Year-Old Behind Pigeon’s Mission!
notes.content:
Watch Logan Play Pigeon’s Mission at Steam Next Fest!

Join us for a heartwarming look behind the feathers as Logan — our 7-year-old designer, as he plays Pigeon’s Mission live with his dad. From sketchbook scribbles to epic boss battles, discover how a kid’s imagination became a full indie game launching this July!



Developer Q&A - Hear how a simple sketchbook turned into a full-fledged platformer — and ask your own questions live.

Live gameplay - Watch Logan play through early levels like Hill Hopping and Splashy Streams, showcasing his favorite moves and inventions.

Sneak peeks at new levels - Get an early look at sky-high zones like Heavenly Hike and the space showdown in Cosmic Craft.

Power-Up Spotlights - See the wild tools and weapons Archie uses to conquer chaos

🌲 Pinecone Launcher – Fires explosive pinecones with a satisfying pop-pop-BOOM!

🌀 DustBuster – A vacuum that clears the screen of enemies in one swoosh!

🔨 Rocky Hammer – Smash barriers and send shockwaves with a powerful ground pound.

🪂 Winged Wonder – A rocket pack that lets Archie fly short distances to reach secret spots.

🌊 Hydro Helm – Breathe underwater and light up dark ocean caves.

🔥 Phoenix Feather – Adds an extra lifebar when charged — perfect for boss battles.

🤖 Tech Mech – A mega-suit of armor for heavy lifting and final fights!

notes.title: IT’S HAPPENING: PIGEON’S MISSION IS COMING TO NEXT FEST!
notes.content:
Grab your feathers and mark your calendars! Pigeon’s Mission is soaring into Steam Next Fest from June 9–15, 2025! 

For the first time ever, you’ll be able to play our public demo and step into the pixel-powered, pigeon-sized shoes of Archie, a brave bird on a heartfelt journey to save his family.

Built from the imagination of a 7-year-old and his dad, this is more than a game—it’s a storybook come to life!

PLAY THE FREE DEMO

 Explore the lush, hand-drawn world of Pepper Pines.
 Try out the Harvest Pulse System.
 Unlock power-ups like the Dust Buster, Winged Wonder, and the pilot of the powerful Tech Mech!
 Dash, jump, and glide your way through pixel-perfect platforming with precision and heart!

No sign-ups. No gatekeeping. Just hop in, explore, and see how far your wings can take you.

JOIN OUR LIVE GAMEPLAY STREAM WITH LOGAN!

We're going live to celebrate the launch of the demo, and you're invited!

 When: June 10th, Tuesday
 Time: 7:00 PM EST
 Watch live on our Steam page

Watch Logan, our 7-year-old Art Director and Co-Founder, takes you through the world born from his imagination. You’ll get behind-the-scenes stories, developer Q&A, and plenty of laughs (and probably some dramatic pinecone launches too).

Don’t forget to Wishlist Pigeon’s Mission to be notified when the demo goes live!

This is a pixel adventure powered by heart, imagination, and a little pigeon who never gives up.

See you in Pepper Pines!


The Glowing Cheetah Team 
(aka Logan & Dad)
